revolved-downward-facing-hero-pose-exten.breath: Exhale as you twist, inhale back to center.

pyramid-pose-over-folded-chair-arms-exte.name: Pyramid over Folded Chair, Arms Forward
pyramid-pose-over-folded-chair-arms-exte.summary: Pyramid (scissor-stance forward fold) with the torso extending over a folded chair and arms reaching forward. It stretches the hamstrings while keeping the back long.

entry: Place a folded chair or its backrest in front of the front foot.
Feet a leg's length apart, hips facing forward.
Hinge from the hips and reach the arms forward onto the chair.
hold: Keep the back flat and the pelvis square.
Adjust the distance for a moderate stretch.
exit: Inhale to lift the torso and switch sides.

tiger-pose-partner.name: Partner Tiger
tiger-pose-partner.summary: A partner version of Tiger: on all fours, lift a bent leg back while the partner assists the stretch or balance. It strengthens back and glutes and opens the chest.

entry: Come to all fours, partner beside or behind you.
Lift one bent leg, foot toward the head.
Option: catch the foot with the opposite hand while the partner steadies.
hold: Open the chest and keep the pelvis steady.
Partner supports without pulling.
exit: Lower the leg, then switch sides and roles.

tiger-pose-partner.breath: Inhale to lift the leg and breathe steadily.

wild-thing-pose-knee-floor-thighs-resist.name: Wild Thing, Knee Down, Resistance Band at Thighs
wild-thing-pose-knee-floor-thighs-resist.summary: A knee-down Wild Thing with a mini loop band around the thighs to activate glutes and abductors. It opens the chest while strengthening the hips.
contraindications: Knee injury: pad with a blanket

entry: Place the band just above the knees.
From a knee-down side plank, step the free foot back.
Lift the hips and reach the free arm overhead.
hold: Press against the band to keep the knees apart.
Open the chest toward the sky.
exit: Lower the hips, return to all fours and switch sides.

wild-thing-pose-knee-floor-thighs-resist.breath: Inhale to open the chest; keep the breath moving.

sleeping-swan-pose-forearms-hip-bed.name: Sleeping Swan on Forearms, Hip Supported
sleeping-swan-pose-forearms-hip-bed.summary: A yin version of Pigeon: front leg bent, back leg extended, torso resting on the forearms, hip supported by a cushion or blanket. It opens the hip deeply and gently.

entry: From all fours, bring the right knee behind the right wrist.
Extend the left leg back.
Slide a cushion under the right hip and lower to the forearms.
hold: Stay several minutes with the pelvis well supported.
Relax shoulders and jaw.
exit: Press back onto the hands, draw the front leg back and switch sides.

sleeping-swan-pose-forearms-hip-bed.breath: Slow, long breathing, especially on the exhale.

humble-warrior-pose-foot-ball.name: Humble Warrior, Foot on Ball
humble-warrior-pose-foot-ball.summary: Humble Warrior with one foot on a ball, adding a stability challenge. It opens shoulders and hips while strongly engaging balance.
contraindications: Balance issues: stay near a wall

entry: Place the ball behind you and rest the back foot on it.
Bend the front knee, hands clasped behind the back.
Exhale and bow the torso inside the front knee.
hold: Steady the ball with the back leg.
Let the arms float away from the back.
exit: Inhale to rise, release the hands and take the foot off the ball.

dragon-pose.name: Dragon
dragon-pose.summary: A long-held low lunge typical of Yin Yoga, back knee down and hands on either side of the front foot. It deeply opens the hips and hip flexors.

entry: From all fours or Down Dog, step one foot between the hands.
Lower the back knee and slide that leg back.
Let the pelvis sink forward.
hold: Stay a few minutes, hands on the floor or blocks.
Variation: hands inside the foot or on the thigh.
exit: Return to all fours or Down Dog, then switch sides.

dragon-pose.breath: Slow breathing, releasing on each exhale.

tail-wagging-pose-7741.name: Tail Wag
tail-wagging-pose-7741.summary: On all fours, turn the head and hips to the same side to look at your 'tail', like a dog. It laterally mobilizes the spine and stretches the side body.

entry: Come to all fours, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
Turn the head right and draw the right hip toward it.
Look over the shoulder toward the feet.
hold: Alternate sides smoothly or hold a few breaths.
Keep hands and knees grounded.
exit: Return to a neutral tabletop.

tail-wagging-pose-7741.breath: Exhale into the curve, inhale back to center.

coq-leve.name: Upward Rooster
coq-leve.summary: An advanced arm balance with the legs in Lotus resting high on the backs of the arms. It requires strength, hip openness and core control.
contraindications: Hips not open enough for Lotus

entry: Take Lotus, then come up onto the knees or enter from Headstand.
Place the hands shoulder-width on the floor.
Set the knees high on the backs of the arms and tip forward to lift.
hold: Straighten the arms and round the back slightly.
Gaze forward, breath steady.
exit: Lower the knees to the floor and release Lotus with the hands.

coq-leve.breath: Short but continuous breath; never hold it.

montagne.name: Mountain
montagne.description: Stand with feet parallel, hip-width apart, weight spread over the four corners of the feet, spine long, shoulders relaxed.

bras-leves.name: Upward Salute
bras-leves.description: From Mountain, inhale and raise the arms overhead, palms facing each other, ribs soft.
benefits: Stretches the sides of the body

pince-debout.name: Standing Forward Bend
pince-debout.description: Hinge from the hips and let the torso hang toward the legs, knees bent if needed, neck relaxed.
benefits: Stretches the backs of the legs

demi-pince-debout.name: Half Standing Forward Bend
demi-pince-debout.description: From Forward Bend, lengthen the back to horizontal, hands on the shins or the floor, gaze toward the front of the mat.

chaise.name: Chair
chaise.description: Feet together or apart, bend the knees as if sitting down, arms raised, weight in the heels.

guerrier-1.name: Warrior I
guerrier-1.description: Long lunge, back foot at 45°, front knee over the ankle, hips facing forward, arms raised.

guerrier-2.name: Warrior II
guerrier-2.description: Legs wide, front foot at 90°, front knee bent over the ankle, arms horizontal, gaze beyond the front hand.

guerrier-3.name: Warrior III
guerrier-3.description: Balance on one leg, torso and back leg in one horizontal line, arms forward or alongside the body.

guerrier-inverse.name: Reverse Warrior
guerrier-inverse.description: From Warrior II, slide the back hand down the back leg and raise the front arm overhead.
benefits: Stretches the sides of the body

triangle.name: Triangle
triangle.description: Legs straight and wide, tilt the torso over the front leg, hand on the shin or a block, top arm reaching to the sky.

triangle-tourne.name: Revolved Triangle
triangle-tourne.description: Legs in Pyramid stance, opposite hand placed near the front foot, rotate the torso, top arm reaching to the sky.

angle-lateral.name: Extended Side Angle
angle-lateral.description: From Warrior II, forearm on the thigh or hand on the floor, top arm extending the line of the back leg.

angle-lateral-tourne.name: Revolved Side Angle
angle-lateral-tourne.description: Lunge, opposite elbow outside the front knee, hands in prayer, rotate the torso toward the sky.

pyramide.name: Pyramid
pyramide.description: Feet staggered, legs straight, hips facing forward, torso lowering over the front leg.

grand-ecart-facial-debout.name: Wide-Legged Forward Bend
grand-ecart-facial-debout.description: Legs very wide, feet parallel, hinge from the hips, hands on the floor or crown of the head toward the floor.

fente-haute.name: High Lunge / Crescent Lunge
fente-haute.description: Long lunge on the ball of the back foot, back leg active, torso upright, arms raised.

guirlande.name: Garland
guirlande.description: Squat with feet slightly turned out, heels down (or on a blanket), elbows against the inner knees, hands in prayer.

arbre.name: Tree
arbre.description: On one leg, sole of the other foot against the ankle, calf or thigh (never on the knee), hands in prayer.

aigle.name: Eagle
aigle.description: Knees bent, one leg wrapped around the other, arms wrapped in front of the face.
benefits: Stretches the shoulders and upper back

danseur.name: Dancer
danseur.description: On one leg, catch the back foot and press the foot into the hand while tipping the torso forward, free arm reaching ahead.

demi-lune.name: Half Moon
demi-lune.description: On one leg, hand on the floor or a block, lifted leg horizontal, hips and chest open to the side.

main-gros-orteil.name: Extended Hand-to-Big-Toe
main-gros-orteil.description: On one leg, catch the big toe of the other leg and extend it forward, then out to the side.
benefits: Stretches the backs of the legs

pince-debout-mains-liees.name: Forward Bend with Shoulder Opener
pince-debout-mains-liees.description: Interlace the fingers behind the back, hinge from the hips and let the arms fall over the head.
benefits: Stretches the backs of the legs

main-au-pied.name: Gorilla / Hand-Under-Foot
main-au-pied.description: From Standing Forward Bend, slide the hands under the feet, palms up, toes to the wrists.

flexion-laterale-debout.name: Standing Side Bend
flexion-laterale-debout.description: Arms raised, palms together, bend the torso to the side while keeping both feet firmly grounded.

chaise-tournee.name: Revolved Chair
chaise-tournee.description: From Chair, hands in prayer, hook the elbow outside the opposite knee and rotate the torso.

deesse.name: Goddess
deesse.description: Legs wide, toes turned out, knees bent over the ankles, arms in cactus.

guerrier-humble.name: Humble Warrior
guerrier-humble.description: From Warrior I, hands clasped behind the back, torso diving inside the front knee.

fente-tournee.name: Revolved Lunge
fente-tournee.description: High lunge, hands in prayer, opposite elbow outside the front knee, rotate the torso.

fente-laterale.name: Side Lunge
fente-laterale.description: Legs wide, bend one knee while lowering the hips, other leg straight, toes toward the sky.

triangle-lie.name: Triangle with Big Toe Hold
triangle-lie.description: As in Triangle, catching the front big toe with two fingers.

demi-lune-tournee.name: Revolved Half Moon
demi-lune-tournee.description: Balance on one leg, opposite hand on the floor, lifted leg horizontal, torso rotated toward the sky.

chaise-une-jambe.name: Standing Figure Four
chaise-une-jambe.description: On one leg with the knee bent, opposite ankle resting on the thigh, hips sitting back.

oiseau-de-paradis.name: Bird of Paradise
oiseau-de-paradis.description: From a bound Side Angle, rise onto one leg and extend the bound leg toward the sky.

demi-lotus-debout.name: Standing Half Lotus Forward Bend
demi-lotus-debout.description: On one leg, opposite foot in half lotus, fold forward, hand on the floor.

montagne-mains-priere.name: Mountain with Prayer Hands
montagne-mains-priere.description: Stand with feet together or hip-width apart, palms together in front of the sternum, thumbs lightly against the chest, calm gaze.

montagne-priere-inversee.name: Reverse Prayer
montagne-priere-inversee.description: From Mountain, join the palms behind the back, fingers pointing up between the shoulder blades, elbows opening back.
benefits: Opens the front of the shoulders and chest
contraindications: Wrist or shoulder injury (hold opposite elbows)

montagne-mains-liees.name: Mountain with Clasped Hands
montagne-mains-liees.description: Fingers interlaced behind the pelvis, straight arms reaching toward the floor, shoulder blades drawing together and sternum lifting.
benefits: Stretches the front of the shoulders

montagne-bras-tete-de-vache.name: Mountain with Cow Face Arms
montagne-bras-tete-de-vache.description: Standing, one arm bent behind the head, the other reaching up the back; fingers meet or hold a strap.

palmier.name: Palm Tree
palmier.description: Arms raised, fingers interlaced with palms to the sky, rise onto the balls of the feet, stretching from the soles to the hands.

etoile.name: Five-Pointed Star
etoile.description: Feet about a leg's length apart, arms open at shoulder height, stretch from the center out through the head, hands and feet.

flexion-arriere-debout.name: Standing Backbend
flexion-arriere-debout.description: Hands on the lower back or arms raised, press the hips slightly forward and open the upper back backward, neck long.
benefits: Opens the chest and front body

torsion-debout.name: Standing Waist Rotation
torsion-debout.description: Feet hip-width apart, turn the torso to one side then the other, letting the arms wrap loosely around the waist.

chat-vache-debout.name: Standing Cat-Cow
chat-vache-debout.description: Knees bent, hands on the thighs, round the back on the exhale and arch it on the inhale, following the breath.
benefits: Warms up the back without loading the wrists

genou-poitrine-debout.name: Standing Knee to Chest
genou-poitrine-debout.description: On one leg, draw the other knee toward the chest and wrap the arms around it, torso upright, standing leg active.
benefits: Stretches the glute and lower back

tete-au-genou-debout.name: Standing Head to Knee
tete-au-genou-debout.description: On a straight standing leg, hold the other foot with both hands, extend that leg forward, then round the torso to bring the forehead toward the knee.
benefits: Strengthens the standing leg and core
Stretches the backs of the legs

pince-gros-orteils.name: Big Toe Pose
pince-gros-orteils.description: Feet hip-width apart, fold forward and hook the big toes with the index and middle fingers, lengthen the back on the inhale, then fold deeper.

poupee-de-chiffon.name: Rag Doll
poupee-de-chiffon.description: Knees soft, torso hanging, each hand holding the opposite elbow; let the head be heavy and sway gently.
benefits: Gently stretches the backs of the legs

pince-debout-genoux-flechis.name: Bent-Knee Forward Fold
pince-debout-genoux-flechis.description: Bend the knees generously to rest the belly on the thighs, hands on the floor, and let the spine lengthen toward the floor.

pince-debout-tournee.name: Revolved Standing Forward Bend
pince-debout-tournee.description: From Forward Bend, one hand on the floor under the face, the other arm opens to the sky as the torso rotates; switch sides.

pince-debout-jambes-croisees.name: Crossed-Leg Forward Fold
pince-debout-jambes-croisees.description: Cross one ankle in front of the other, feet side by side, and fold forward; the stretch moves to the outside of the back leg.
benefits: Stretches the outer leg and hip

grand-ecart-debout.name: Standing Split
grand-ecart-debout.description: From Forward Bend, hands on the floor or blocks, lift one straight leg toward the sky, keeping the hips as square as possible.

pyramide-dos-plat.name: Half Pyramid
pyramide-dos-plat.description: Feet staggered in Pyramid, hands on blocks or the shin, back lengthened to horizontal, hips facing forward.
benefits: Stretches the hamstrings without rounding the back

pyramide-mains-priere.name: Pyramid with Reverse Prayer
pyramide-mains-priere.description: In Pyramid, palms together behind the back, lengthen the torso over the front leg while keeping the chest open.

demi-ecart-facial.name: Half Wide-Legged Forward Bend
demi-ecart-facial.description: Legs wide, hands on the floor under the shoulders, back flat and lengthening forward, gaze slightly ahead.

ecart-facial-mains-taille.name: Wide-Legged Forward Bend, Hands on Hips
ecart-facial-mains-taille.description: Legs wide, hands on the hips, lower the torso toward the floor, keeping the elbows wide and the legs active.
benefits: Stretches the inner and back legs

ecart-facial-mains-liees.name: Wide-Legged Forward Bend with Clasped Hands
ecart-facial-mains-liees.description: Legs wide, fingers interlaced behind the back, hinge from the hips and let the arms fall toward the floor in front of you.

ecart-facial-tourne.name: Revolved Wide-Legged Forward Bend
ecart-facial-tourne.description: Legs wide in a forward fold, one hand on the floor at the center, the other arm rises toward the sky as the torso rotates.

chaise-mains-priere.name: Chair with Prayer Hands
chaise-mains-priere.description: Knees bent as if sitting down, weight in the heels, palms together in front of the heart, torso long.

chaise-pointes.name: Tiptoe Chair
chaise-pointes.description: From Chair, lift the heels and keep the knees bent, arms forward or in prayer, core engaged.

chaise-tournee-bras-ouverts.name: Revolved Chair with Open Arms
chaise-tournee-bras-ouverts.description: In Revolved Chair, bottom hand outside the foot or on a block, top arm opening toward the sky.

pigeon-debout-penche.name: Standing Figure Four Forward Fold
pigeon-debout-penche.description: From Standing Figure Four, tip the torso forward until the hands reach the floor, ankle still on the standing thigh.

guirlande-tournee.name: Revolved Garland
guirlande-tournee.description: Squatting, one hand on the floor, the other arm opens to the sky as the torso rotates; or elbow against the opposite knee, hands in prayer.

guirlande-liee.name: Bound Garland
guirlande-liee.description: Squatting with feet close together, torso forward, arms wrapping around the legs and hands meeting behind the back.

accroupi-pointes.name: Tiptoe Squat
accroupi-pointes.description: Squatting with knees together, heels lifted, hips over the heels, hands in prayer in front of the chest.

guerrier-1-mains-priere.name: Warrior I with Prayer Hands
guerrier-1-mains-priere.description: Legs in Warrior I, palms together in front of the heart or overhead, shoulders down and hips facing forward.
benefits: Reduces the load on the shoulders

guerrier-1-bras-aigle.name: Warrior I with Eagle Arms
guerrier-1-bras-aigle.description: Legs in Warrior I, arms wrapped in front of the face as in Eagle, elbows lifting, torso slightly rounded.
benefits: Stretches the upper back and shoulders

fente-haute-poitrine-ouverte.name: High Lunge with Chest Opener
fente-haute-poitrine-ouverte.description: In high lunge, fingers interlaced behind the back, arms reaching back, sternum lifting and shoulder blades drawing together.

fente-haute-flexion-arriere.name: Crescent Lunge Backbend
fente-haute-flexion-arriere.description: In high lunge, arms raised, lift the sternum and open the upper back backward without compressing the lower back.

fente-haute-torsion-ouverte.name: Twisted High Lunge, Open Arms
fente-haute-torsion-ouverte.description: In high lunge, place the opposite hand on the floor inside the front foot and open the other arm toward the sky as the torso rotates.

fente-haute-mains-au-sol.name: Runner's Lunge
fente-haute-mains-au-sol.description: Front foot between the hands, back knee lifted and back leg straight, chest forward, gaze slightly ahead.

angle-lateral-lie.name: Bound Extended Side Angle
angle-lateral-lie.description: From Side Angle, the bottom arm wraps under the front thigh and the top arm behind the back so the hands meet.

angle-lateral-tourne-lie.name: Bound Revolved Side Angle
angle-lateral-tourne-lie.description: From Revolved Side Angle, wrap the bottom arm under the front thigh and bind the hands behind the back, chest turning toward the sky.

triangle-demi-lie.name: Bound Triangle
triangle-demi-lie.description: In Triangle, the top arm goes behind the back and the bottom arm under the front thigh; the hands meet or hold a strap.

fente-laterale-tournee.name: Revolved Side Lunge
fente-laterale-tournee.description: In Side Lunge, one hand on the floor, the other arm opens toward the sky above the bent knee as the torso rotates.
benefits: Opens the hips and inner thighs

deesse-pointes.name: Goddess on Tiptoes
deesse-pointes.description: From Goddess, lift both heels while keeping the knees open over the feet, torso upright.

deesse-tournee.name: Revolved Goddess
deesse-tournee.description: In Goddess, hands on the thighs, drop one shoulder toward the inside of the opposite knee as the torso rotates.

deesse-inclinee.name: Goddess Side Bend
deesse-inclinee.description: In Goddess, forearm on the thigh, the other arm reaches over the ear to stretch the whole side body.
benefits: Stretches the sides of the body

arbre-pied-au-sol.name: Kickstand Tree
arbre-pied-au-sol.description: Heel resting against the standing ankle, toes on the floor, knee open to the side, hands in prayer or on the hips.

arbre-bras-leves.name: Tree with Raised Arms
arbre-bras-leves.description: In Tree, raise the arms in a V or palms together overhead like branches, shoulders away from the ears.
benefits: Stretches the sides of the body

arbre-incline.name: Swaying Tree
arbre-incline.description: In Tree with raised arms, gently bend the torso to the side like a branch in the wind, keeping the hips steady.
benefits: Stretches the sides of the body

arbre-demi-lotus.name: Half Lotus Tree
arbre-demi-lotus.description: On one leg, place the top of the opposite foot high on the standing thigh, knee toward the floor, hands in prayer.

aigle-penche.name: Eagle Forward Fold
aigle-penche.description: In Eagle, round the torso forward to bring the elbows toward the top knee, staying low in the legs.

danseur-preparation.name: Standing Quad Stretch
danseur-preparation.description: On one leg, catch the back foot and draw the heel toward the glute, knees side by side, pelvis slightly tucked.
benefits: Stretches the quadriceps and front of the hip

danseur-deux-mains.name: King Dancer
danseur-deux-mains.description: On one leg, both hands catch the back foot overhead, elbows to the sky, in a deep backbend.
benefits: Deeply opens the shoulders and chest

canne-a-sucre.name: Sugarcane
canne-a-sucre.description: From Half Moon, bend the lifted leg and catch the foot with the top hand, pulling to open the front body.

guerrier-3-mains-priere.name: Warrior III with Prayer Hands
guerrier-3-mains-priere.description: In Warrior III, palms together in front of the heart, torso and back leg horizontal, hips level.
benefits: Strengthens the standing leg and back
More accessible than with arms extended

avion.name: Airplane
avion.description: In Warrior III, arms extended back alongside the body, palms facing down, chest reaching forward.
benefits: Strengthens the back, glutes and standing leg

guerrier-3-tourne.name: Revolved Warrior III
guerrier-3-tourne.description: In Warrior III, torso and back leg horizontal, turn the chest to the side: one arm reaches toward the floor, the other toward the sky.

main-gros-orteil-cote.name: Extended Hand-to-Big-Toe, Side
main-gros-orteil-cote.description: On one leg, hold the big toe of the other leg and open it to the side, hips steady, free arm extended the opposite way.
benefits: Opens the hip and inner thigh
Stretches the back of the leg

main-gros-orteil-tourne.name: Revolved Hand-to-Big-Toe
main-gros-orteil-tourne.description: On one leg, the opposite hand holds the foot of the leg extended in front, the other arm opens back as the torso rotates.

jambe-tendue-devant.name: Extended Leg Hold, Hands Free
jambe-tendue-devant.description: On one leg, lift the other leg straight in front and hold it without the hands, hands on the hips, torso upright.
benefits: Strengthens the hip flexors and core

cheval.name: Horse Face
cheval.description: One foot in half lotus, bend the standing leg until the bent knee rests near the standing heel, arms wrapped as in Eagle.
benefits: Strengthens the standing ankle and knee

trivikramasana.name: Standing Split with Leg Overhead
trivikramasana.description: On a straight standing leg, hold the foot of the other leg and bring it vertical above the head, alongside the ear.
benefits: Intensely stretches the back of the leg

equerre-au-mur.name: Half Forward Bend at the Wall
equerre-au-mur.description: Facing a wall, hands at hip height, step back until forming a right angle, back flat, feet under the hips.
benefits: Stretches the backs of the legs without load

equilibre-orteils.name: Toe Stand
equilibre-orteils.description: From Half Lotus Tree, bend the standing leg until sitting on the lifted heel, hands in prayer, lotus knee toward the floor.

fente-basse.name: Low Lunge
fente-basse.description: Back knee on the floor, front knee over the ankle, hips sinking, arms raised.
contraindications: Pain in the grounded knee (add a blanket)

quatre-pattes.name: Tabletop
quatre-pattes.description: Hands under the shoulders, knees under the hips, neutral spine.

chat.name: Cat
chat.description: On all fours, exhale and round the back, chin toward the chest, navel drawn in.

vache.name: Cow
vache.description: On all fours, inhale and arch the back, belly toward the floor, gaze slightly forward.

planche-avant-bras.name: Forearm Plank
planche-avant-bras.description: Forearms on the floor, elbows under the shoulders, body in one line.
benefits: Strengthens the core without loading the wrists

enfant.name: Child's Pose
enfant.description: Sit on the heels, torso resting on the thighs, forehead on the floor, arms forward or alongside the body.

chameau.name: Camel
chameau.description: Kneeling, hands on the lower back or on the heels, hips over the knees, chest toward the sky.
benefits: Opens the chest and hip flexors

heros.name: Hero
heros.description: Kneeling, sit between the heels (or on a block), feet pointing back.

bateau.name: Boat
bateau.description: Balance on the sit bones, legs lifted (straight or bent), torso reclined, arms parallel to the floor.
benefits: Strengthens the abdominals and hip flexors

oiseau-chien.name: Bird Dog
oiseau-chien.description: On all fours, extend one arm forward and the opposite leg back, back stable.

fil-aiguille.name: Thread the Needle
fil-aiguille.description: On all fours, slide one arm under the other and rest the shoulder and temple on the floor.
benefits: Releases the shoulders and upper back

chiot.name: Puppy
chiot.description: Hips over the knees, arms extended forward, chest melting toward the floor.

demi-grand-ecart.name: Half Splits
demi-grand-ecart.description: From Low Lunge, shift the hips back over the back knee and straighten the front leg, foot flexed.

porte.name: Gate
porte.description: Kneeling, one leg extended to the side, bend the torso toward the extended leg, arm reaching overhead.
benefits: Stretches the sides of the body

grenouille.name: Frog
grenouille.description: Knees very wide, shins parallel, ankles in line with the knees, forearms on the floor, hips shifting back.
benefits: Deeply opens the hips and groin

lion.name: Lion
lion.description: Sitting on the heels, hands on the knees, exhale with the mouth wide open, tongue out, gaze up.

diamant.name: Thunderbolt
diamant.description: Sitting on the heels, knees together, spine upright, hands on the thighs.

planche-genoux.name: Half Plank
planche-genoux.description: Plank with the knees on the floor, body in one line from knees to head.
benefits: Gently strengthens the core and arms

huit-points.name: Knees-Chest-Chin
huit-points.description: From Plank, lower the knees, chest and chin to the floor, hips high, elbows hugging in.

chameau-demi.name: Half Camel
chameau-demi.description: Kneeling, one hand on the heel, the other arm raised, chest opening toward the sky.

enfant-etendu.name: Wide-Knee Child's Pose
enfant-etendu.description: Knees wide, big toes together, torso sinking between the thighs, arms extended forward.

table-inversee.name: Reverse Tabletop
table-inversee.description: Seated, hands behind, feet on the floor, lift the hips to form a table, chest open.

planche-inversee.name: Upward Plank
planche-inversee.description: Seated with legs straight, hands behind, lift the hips to bring the body into one line, feet on the floor.

demi-bateau.name: Half Boat
demi-bateau.description: Balance on the sit bones, knees bent, shins parallel to the floor, arms extended forward.

enfant-soutenu.name: Supported Child's Pose
enfant-soutenu.description: Torso resting on a bolster between wide knees, head turned to the side.

tigre.name: Tiger Pose
tigre.description: From Bird Dog, bend the knee of the lifted leg and catch the foot with the opposite hand reaching back, chest open.
benefits: Stretches the quadriceps and front of the shoulder
contraindications: Injury to the knee of the lifted leg

quatre-pattes-torsion.name: Tabletop Twist
quatre-pattes-torsion.description: On all fours, keep one hand under the shoulder and open the other arm toward the sky as the chest turns, gaze toward the lifted hand.
benefits: Mobilizes the upper back in rotation

chat-lateral.name: Side Cat
chat-lateral.description: On all fours, hands and knees fixed, draw the shoulder and hip of the same side together so the spine forms a C, gaze toward the hip.

cercles-quatre-pattes.name: Tabletop Circles
cercles-quatre-pattes.description: On all fours, draw large circles with the torso and hips, passing over the hands then the knees, in one direction then the other.
benefits: Warms up the shoulders, hips and spine

etirement-poignets.name: Tabletop Wrist Stretch
etirement-poignets.description: On all fours, turn the hands so the fingers point toward the knees, palms on the floor, and gently shift the hips back to the desired intensity.
benefits: Stretches the wrist and forearm flexors
Prepares for weight-bearing on the hands
contraindications: Carpal tunnel or wrist injury (adjust the intensity)

table-flottante.name: Hovering Tabletop
table-flottante.description: On all fours, toes tucked, lift the knees a few centimeters while keeping the back flat and the belly engaged.
benefits: Engages shoulders and thighs without loading the back

chien-oiseau-contraction.name: Bird Dog Crunch
chien-oiseau-contraction.description: From Bird Dog, exhale as you round the back and draw the knee toward the forehead (or the opposite elbow), then lengthen again.

chiot-bloc.name: Puppy with Elbows on a Block
chiot-bloc.description: Hips over the knees, elbows on a block shoulder-width apart, hands together behind the neck, chest melting toward the floor.

enfant-lateral.name: Side Child's Pose
enfant-lateral.description: From Child's Pose with arms extended, walk both hands to one side and let the hips stay on the heels to stretch the opposite side body.

demi-tortue.name: Half Tortoise
demi-tortue.description: Sitting on the heels, arms extended overhead, palms together, fold forward until the forehead and fingertips touch the floor, glutes on the heels.

lapin.name: Rabbit
lapin.description: Sitting on the heels, hold the heels, curl the back to place the crown of the head on the floor near the knees, then lift the hips.
benefits: Stretches the full length of the back

lievre-cobra.name: Striking Cobra
lievre-cobra.description: From Child's Pose with arms extended, glide the chest forward close to the floor into Cobra, then return the same way, following the breath.

cavalier.name: Equestrian Pose
cavalier.description: Front foot between the hands, back knee on the floor, chest close to the front thigh, hands on the floor on either side of the foot, gaze forward.
benefits: Stretches the psoas of the back leg
contraindications: Pain in the grounded knee (add a blanket)

fente-basse-extension.name: Low Lunge Backbend
fente-basse-extension.description: In Low Lunge, arms raised, lift the sternum and arch the upper back, keeping the lower back long and the hips sinking.
benefits: Opens the chest and hip flexors

fente-basse-laterale.name: Low Lunge Side Bend
fente-basse-laterale.description: In Low Lunge, the hand on the front-leg side rests on the thigh, the other arm reaches overhead to bend the torso toward the front leg.
benefits: Stretches the psoas and side body on the back-leg side
contraindications: Pain in the grounded knee (add a blanket)

fente-basse-tournee.name: Revolved Low Lunge
fente-basse-tournee.description: From Low Lunge, place the hand opposite the front leg on the floor and open the other arm toward the sky, turning the chest toward the front knee.
benefits: Combines a twist with a psoas stretch

fente-basse-pied-main.name: Low Lunge Quad Stretch
fente-basse-pied-main.description: In Low Lunge, bend the back leg and catch the foot with the same-side hand, heel toward the glute, hips gently moving forward.
benefits: Intensely stretches the quadriceps and hip flexors

fente-basse-mains-liees.name: Low Lunge with Clasped Hands
fente-basse-mains-liees.description: In Low Lunge, interlace the fingers behind the back, extend the arms back and open the chest.
benefits: Opens the chest and front of the shoulders
Stretches the psoas of the back leg

roi-pigeon-fente.name: One-Legged King Pigeon II
roi-pigeon-fente.description: In Low Lunge, bend the back leg and catch the foot overhead with both hands, elbows to the sky, chest wide open.
benefits: Deeply opens the front body and shoulders

tete-de-cheval.name: Horse Face Pose
tete-de-cheval.description: One foot in half lotus with its knee on the floor, the other foot flat beside the knee, hips high, torso upright and hands together in front of the chest.
benefits: Opens the hip in external rotation
contraindications: Tight hips (prepare the half lotus first)

porte-tournee.name: Revolved Gate
porte-tournee.description: From Gate, turn the chest toward the extended leg, slide the hand toward the foot and extend the other arm over the ear.
benefits: Stretches the sides and back of the leg

diamant-torsion.name: Thunderbolt Twist
diamant-torsion.description: Sitting on the heels, one hand on the opposite knee, the other on the floor behind you, lengthen and then rotate the torso starting from the navel.

kapotasana.name: Kneeling Pigeon
kapotasana.description: Kneeling, hips forward, arch the whole back until the forearms and crown of the head rest on the floor, hands toward the heels.
benefits: Deeply opens the chest and shoulders

laghu-vajrasana.name: Little Thunderbolt
laghu-vajrasana.description: Kneeling, hands on the ankles, press the hips forward and let the head drop until the crown rests on the floor between the feet.
benefits: Strengthens the thighs in a lengthened position

planche-une-jambe.name: One-Legged Plank
planche-une-jambe.description: From Plank, lift one straight leg to hip height without letting the hips tilt.

planche-genou-nez.name: Plank Knee to Nose
planche-genou-nez.description: From Plank, exhale as you round the upper back and draw one knee toward the nose, shoulders over the wrists.

planche-avant-bras-genoux.name: Kneeling Forearm Plank
planche-avant-bras-genoux.description: Forearms on the floor, elbows under the shoulders, knees down behind, body in one line from knees to head.
benefits: Strengthens the core without loading the wrists

planche-avant-bras-une-jambe.name: One-Legged Forearm Plank
planche-avant-bras-une-jambe.description: In Forearm Plank, lift one straight leg without arching the lower back, hips parallel to the floor.

chaturanga-genoux.name: Kneeling Chaturanga
chaturanga-genoux.description: From Half Plank, bend the elbows back along the ribs and lower the body as one unit to halfway.

planche-laterale-genou.name: Half Side Plank
planche-laterale-genou.description: Hand under the shoulder and same-side knee on the floor, top leg straight, hips lifted, top arm toward the sky.

planche-laterale-avant-bras.name: Forearm Side Plank
planche-laterale-avant-bras.description: Elbow under the shoulder, forearm on the floor, legs straight and feet stacked, hips lifted in line with the body.
benefits: Strengthens the obliques and shoulder stabilizers

planche-laterale-avant-bras-genou.name: Kneeling Forearm Side Plank
planche-laterale-avant-bras-genou.description: Forearm on the floor, elbow under the shoulder, knees bent and down, hips lifted to align knees, hips and shoulders.
benefits: Loads neither the wrists nor the feet

planche-laterale-jambe-levee.name: Side Plank with Leg Lift
planche-laterale-jambe-levee.description: In Side Plank, lift the straight top leg, foot flexed, without letting the hips sag.
benefits: Intensely strengthens the obliques and abductors
Demands stability of the supporting shoulder

planche-laterale-arbre.name: Side Plank Tree
planche-laterale-arbre.description: In Side Plank, bend the top leg and place the sole of the foot against the inner standing thigh, knee opening toward the sky.

planche-inversee-jambe-levee.name: One-Legged Upward Plank
planche-inversee-jambe-levee.description: In Upward Plank, hips high, lift one straight leg toward the sky while keeping the hips level.
benefits: Adds a balance and stability challenge

table-inversee-jambe-levee.name: One-Legged Reverse Tabletop
table-inversee-jambe-levee.description: In Reverse Tabletop, extend one leg forward, then lift it to hip height without letting the hips drop.

bateau-bas.name: Low Boat
bateau-bas.description: From Boat, lower the torso and straight legs close to the floor without touching down, lower back anchored, arms reaching toward the feet.

bateau-tourne.name: Revolved Boat
bateau-tourne.description: In Half Boat, hands together in front of the chest, rotate the torso to bring one elbow outside the opposite knee.

baton.name: Staff
baton.description: Seated, legs straight in front, feet flexed, hands beside the hips, spine upright.
contraindications: Lower back injury (sit on a blanket)

facile.name: Easy Pose
facile.description: Sit cross-legged, spine upright, hands on the knees.

lotus.name: Lotus
lotus.description: Seated, each foot resting on the opposite thigh, spine upright.

pince-assise.name: Seated Forward Bend
pince-assise.description: Seated with legs straight, lengthen the spine, then hinge from the hips toward the feet.

tete-au-genou.name: Head-to-Knee
tete-au-genou.description: One leg straight, sole of the other foot against the inner thigh, torso folding over the straight leg.

papillon.name: Bound Angle / Butterfly
papillon.description: Seated, soles of the feet together, knees opening toward the floor, spine upright.

grand-angle-assis.name: Wide-Angle Seated Forward Bend
grand-angle-assis.description: Seated with legs very wide, feet flexed, torso moving forward toward the floor.

demi-seigneur-poissons.name: Half Lord of the Fishes
demi-seigneur-poissons.description: Seated, one leg crossed over the other, rotate the torso toward the raised knee, elbow against the outside of the knee.

pigeon.name: Pigeon
pigeon.description: Front shin across the mat, back leg extended, hips sinking, torso upright or folded forward.

roi-pigeon.name: King Pigeon
roi-pigeon.description: From Pigeon, bend the back leg and catch the foot overhead.
benefits: Opens the hips, chest and shoulders

lezard.name: Lizard
lezard.description: Low lunge with both hands (or forearms) inside the front foot.

grand-ecart.name: Splits
grand-ecart.description: One leg straight in front, the other behind, hips sinking toward the floor (use blocks).
benefits: Stretches the hamstrings and hip flexors

grand-ecart-lateral.name: Side Splits
grand-ecart-lateral.description: Legs open to each side down to the floor, hips centered, torso upright or folding forward.

tete-vache.name: Cow Face
tete-vache.description: Knees stacked, feet on either side of the hips, one hand reaching down the back from above, the other from below.

tete-genou-tournee.name: Revolved Head-to-Knee
tete-genou-tournee.description: As in Head-to-Knee, but bending the side body toward the straight leg, top arm reaching over the ear.
benefits: Stretches the sides of the body

marichyasana-3.name: Marichi's Twist
marichyasana-3.description: Seated, one leg straight, the other foot on the floor near the hip, rotate toward the raised knee.

torsion-assise-simple.name: Easy Seated Twist
torsion-assise-simple.description: Seated cross-legged, one hand on the opposite knee, the other behind you, gentle rotation.

double-pigeon.name: Fire Log
double-pigeon.description: Seated, shins stacked and parallel to the front edge of the mat, feet flexed.

accomplie.name: Accomplished Pose
accomplie.description: Seated, one heel near the perineum, the other in front, knees on the floor, spine upright.

tortue.name: Tortoise
tortue.description: Seated with legs wide and knees slightly bent, slide the arms under the knees and lower the torso.

bharadvaja.name: Bharadvaja's Twist
bharadvaja.description: Seated, legs folded to one side, rotate the torso toward the opposite side.

berceau.name: Rock the Baby
berceau.description: Seated, cradle one shin in the arms, foot in one elbow and knee in the other.

demi-lotus.name: Half Lotus
demi-lotus.description: Seated, one foot placed high on the opposite thigh, the other foot tucked under the opposite knee, spine upright.

lotus-lie.name: Bound Lotus
lotus-lie.description: In Lotus, cross the arms behind the back and catch the big toe of the opposite foot with each hand, chest open.
benefits: Deeply opens the shoulders and chest

yoga-mudra.name: Yoga Seal
yoga-mudra.description: In Lotus (or cross-legged), hands clasped behind the back, curl the torso forward until the forehead rests on the floor.

montagne-assise.name: Seated Mountain
montagne-assise.description: Seated cross-legged (or in Lotus), fingers interlaced, palms turned to the sky, arms extended overhead.
benefits: Lengthens the spine and side body
Wakes up energy at the start of class

swastikasana.name: Auspicious Pose
swastikasana.description: Seated, each foot tucked between the thigh and calf of the opposite leg, knees toward the floor, spine upright.

flexion-avant-jambes-croisees.name: Forward Easy Pose
flexion-avant-jambes-croisees.description: From Easy Pose, walk the hands forward and let the torso lower, then switch the cross of the legs.
benefits: Stretches the lower back and outer hips

etirement-lateral-assis.name: Seated Side Bend
etirement-lateral-assis.description: Seated cross-legged, one hand on the floor beside the hip, the other arm rises and reaches overhead to lengthen the side body.

embryon.name: Embryo in the Womb
embryon.description: In Lotus, slide the arms between thighs and calves, bend the elbows to bring the hands toward the face and balance on the sit bones.

chat-vache-assis.name: Seated Cat-Cow
chat-vache-assis.description: Seated cross-legged, hands on the knees: open the chest on the inhale, round the back on the exhale.

cercles-buste-assis.name: Seated Torso Circles
cercles-buste-assis.description: Seated cross-legged, hands on the knees, draw large circles with the torso around the sit bones, in one direction then the other.
benefits: Mobilizes the pelvis and lower back
Ideal at the start of class

etirement-cou-assis.name: Seated Neck Stretch
etirement-cou-assis.description: Seated, shoulders relaxed, tilt the ear toward the shoulder; the same-side hand can rest on the head without pulling.

bras-aigle-assis.name: Seated Eagle Arms
bras-aigle-assis.description: Seated cross-legged, wrap one arm around the other in front of the face, elbows at shoulder height.
benefits: Stretches the upper back between the shoulder blades

bras-tete-vache-assis.name: Seated Cow Face Arms
bras-tete-vache-assis.description: Seated cross-legged, one hand reaches down the back from above, the other climbs up from below to meet it (use a strap if needed).

barattage.name: Churning the Mill
barattage.description: Seated with legs straight and wide, hands clasped and arms extended, trace large horizontal circles with the torso as if turning a millstone.
benefits: Mobilizes the hips and lower back

ramer.name: Rowing the Boat
ramer.description: Seated with legs straight, hands closed as if on oars: lean forward with arms extended, then pull back toward you while leaning the torso back.
benefits: Warms up the back and shoulders

essuie-glace-assis.name: Seated Windshield Wipers
essuie-glace-assis.description: Seated, hands on the floor behind you, feet wide and flat: let both knees drop to one side, then the other.

demi-pince-assise.name: Half Seated Forward Bend
demi-pince-assise.description: Seated with legs straight, hands on the shins, lengthen the back flat as the chest moves forward, without rounding.

pince-assise-tournee.name: Revolved Seated Forward Bend
pince-assise-tournee.description: From Seated Forward Bend, catch the outside of the opposite foot and open the other arm upward as the rib cage rotates.
benefits: Combines a hamstring stretch with a twist
Stretches the sides of the body

pince-assise-equilibre.name: Upward Seated Forward Bend
pince-assise-equilibre.description: Balancing on the sit bones, legs extended toward the sky, hands around the feet, draw the torso toward the legs.
benefits: Intensely stretches the backs of the legs

equilibre-gros-orteils.name: Both Big Toes Pose
equilibre-gros-orteils.description: Balancing on the sit bones, hold the big toes and extend both legs into a V, chest open.
benefits: Strengthens the abdominals and hip flexors

demi-lotus-pince.name: Half Bound Lotus Forward Bend
demi-lotus-pince.description: One foot in half lotus high on the opposite thigh, catch that foot from behind the back and fold toward the straight leg.
benefits: Stretches the back of the straight leg
contraindications: Knee injury (the bent leg must not hurt)

pince-une-jambe-heros.name: Three-Limbed Forward Bend
pince-une-jambe-heros.description: One leg straight, the other folded back beside the hip as in Hero, fold over the straight leg while keeping the pelvis level.

heron.name: Heron
heron.description: One leg folded in Hero, the other extended toward the sky and held by the foot, upright torso drawing toward the lifted leg.

marichyasana-1.name: Marichi's Pose I
marichyasana-1.description: One leg straight, the other foot on the floor near the hip; the same-side arm wraps the shin, hands bound behind the back, torso lengthening toward the straight leg.
benefits: Stretches the back and the back of the leg

marichyasana-2.name: Marichi's Pose II
marichyasana-2.description: As in Marichi's Pose I, but the extended leg is placed in half lotus; hands bound around the raised knee, torso folding forward.

grand-angle-lateral.name: Side Wide-Angle Seated Bend
grand-angle-lateral.description: Legs very wide, turn the torso toward one leg and lengthen over it, hands on either side of the foot.

grand-angle-equilibre.name: Upward Wide-Angle Seated Pose
grand-angle-equilibre.description: Balancing on the sit bones, hold the big toes and extend the legs wide in a V toward the sky, back long.

tortue-endormie.name: Sleeping Tortoise
tortue-endormie.description: From Tortoise, cross the ankles behind the head and bind the hands behind the back, forehead toward the floor.
benefits: Extreme forward fold and hip opening

archer.name: Archer
archer.description: Seated with legs straight, catch both big toes, then draw one foot up to the ear like drawing a bow, the other leg stays extended.

tete-genou-b.name: Head-to-Knee B
tete-genou-b.description: As in Head-to-Knee, but sitting on the heel of the bent leg (knee open at about 85°), then fold toward the straight leg.
benefits: Stretches the groin and the back of the leg

tete-genou-c.name: Head-to-Knee C
tete-genou-c.description: The foot of the bent leg is turned over, toes on the floor and heel up, knee forward on a diagonal; fold toward the straight leg.
benefits: Increases ankle and knee flexibility in rotation
Stretches the back of the straight leg

tete-vache-flexion-avant.name: Forward Cow Face
tete-vache-flexion-avant.description: Legs in Cow Face, knees stacked, hands walking forward on the floor in front of the knees, torso lowering.

papillon-flexion-avant.name: Forward Bound Angle
papillon-flexion-avant.description: Soles of the feet together, hands around the feet, tilt the pelvis to bring the belly toward the feet while keeping the back long.
benefits: Opens the groin and inner thighs

grand-ecart-flexion-avant.name: Splits Forward Fold
grand-ecart-flexion-avant.description: From Splits (on blocks if needed), place your hands on either side of the front leg and lengthen your torso out over it.
benefits: Calms the body after dynamic work

pince-assise-soutenue.name: Supported Seated Forward Bend
pince-assise-soutenue.description: Sit with legs extended (knees slightly bent over a cushion if needed), torso resting on a bolster or blankets, forehead supported.

grand-angle-soutenu.name: Supported Wide-Angle Seated Bend
grand-angle-soutenu.description: Legs comfortably wide, a bolster lengthwise between them; let your torso and forehead rest on it.

grand-angle-tourne.name: Revolved Wide-Angle Seated Bend
grand-angle-tourne.description: Legs wide apart, side-bend toward one leg, top arm reaching over the ear toward that foot, chest turning up toward the ceiling.
benefits: Stretches the side body and inner legs

demi-seigneur-poissons-lie.name: Bound Half Lord of the Fishes
demi-seigneur-poissons-lie.description: From Half Lord of the Fishes, wrap your arm under the raised knee and clasp the other hand behind your back.

seigneur-poissons.name: Full Lord of the Fishes
seigneur-poissons.description: Bottom leg in half lotus, other foot placed outside the knee; twist fully, with the hand catching the foot.

marichyasana-4.name: Marichi's Pose IV
marichyasana-4.description: One leg in half lotus, the other foot on the floor near the hip; twist toward the raised knee and bind the hands behind your back.

bharadvaja-2.name: Bharadvaja's Twist II
bharadvaja-2.description: One leg in half lotus, the other folded back in Hero; turn toward the half-lotus knee and reach behind your back to catch that foot.
benefits: A grounded, symmetrical twist for the pelvis

torsion-jambes-tendues.name: Revolved Staff
torsion-jambes-tendues.description: In Staff, place one hand on the floor behind you and the other outside the opposite thigh; rotate your torso as you lengthen the spine.

torsion-lotus.name: Revolved Lotus
torsion-lotus.description: In Lotus, one hand on the opposite knee, the other on the floor behind you; rotate your torso from the base of the spine.
benefits: Stable twist on a wide base

chiffre-4-assis.name: Seated Figure Four
chiffre-4-assis.description: Seated, hands on the floor behind you, one foot flat, the other ankle resting on that knee; draw your chest toward the shin.

pigeon-dormant.name: Sleeping Pigeon
pigeon-dormant.description: In Pigeon, lower your torso over the front leg and rest your forehead on your hands or a cushion.
benefits: Deeply releases the glutes and hip

pigeon-quadriceps.name: Pigeon Quad Stretch
pigeon-quadriceps.description: In Pigeon, bend the back leg and catch the foot with the same-side hand, drawing it toward your glutes.
benefits: Stretches the back-leg quadriceps and psoas
Opens the front of the hip

sirene.name: Mermaid
sirene.description: In Pigeon, hook the back foot into the crook of your elbow, then clasp your hands overhead with the chest open.
benefits: Opens the hips, quadriceps and shoulders

pigeon-tourne.name: Twisted Pigeon
pigeon-tourne.description: In Pigeon, one hand on the floor, reach the other arm up toward the ceiling, turning your chest toward the front knee.

lezard-tourne.name: Twisted Lizard
lezard-tourne.description: In Lizard with the back knee down, bend the back leg and catch the foot with the opposite hand as you turn your chest.

compas.name: Compass
compas.description: Seated, one leg tucked behind the shoulder and extended up, held by the opposite hand overhead; the other leg stretched along the floor.
benefits: Stretches the hamstrings and side body

jambe-derriere-tete.name: Foot-Behind-the-Head
jambe-derriere-tete.description: Seated, slide one leg behind the shoulder and then behind the neck, the other leg extended, hands together in front of the chest.

deux-jambes-derriere-tete.name: Both Feet Behind the Head
deux-jambes-derriere-tete.description: Balancing on the sit bones, both legs crossed behind the neck, hands together in front of the chest.

assise-chaise.name: Seated Chair Pose
assise-chaise.description: Sit at the edge of a chair, feet flat and hip-width apart, hands on the thighs, spine tall without leaning on the backrest.
benefits: A meditation seat accessible to everyone
Grounds the posture and the breath

torsion-chaise.name: Chair Twist
torsion-chaise.description: Seated on a chair, knees aligned, one hand on the opposite knee and the other on the backrest; rotate your torso as you lengthen the spine.
benefits: Mobilizes the spine without loading the knees

flexion-avant-chaise.name: Chair Forward Bend
flexion-avant-chaise.description: Seated on a chair, feet apart, let your torso fold down between or onto your thighs, arms and head relaxed toward the floor.
contraindications: Glaucoma or uncontrolled high blood pressure (keep the head up)

pigeon-chaise.name: Chair Pigeon
pigeon-chaise.description: Seated on a chair, rest your ankle on the opposite knee with the foot flexed, and hinge forward with a long back.

guerrier-chaise.name: Chair Warrior II
guerrier-chaise.description: Sit sideways on a chair, one thigh supported with the knee bent, the other leg extended to the side with the foot on the floor, arms open at shoulder height.

chat-vache-chaise.name: Chair Cat-Cow
chat-vache-chaise.description: Seated on a chair, hands on your knees: open the chest as you inhale, round the back as you exhale.
benefits: Accessible for people with limited mobility

ischios-chaise.name: Chair Hamstring Stretch
ischios-chaise.description: Sitting at the edge of a chair, one leg extended with the heel down and foot flexed; hinge toward that leg with a long back.
benefits: Stretches the back of the leg
No need to get down to the floor

aigle-chaise.name: Chair Eagle
aigle-chaise.description: Seated on a chair, cross one thigh over the other and wrap your arms in Eagle, elbows at shoulder height.
benefits: Opens the upper back and outer hips

bras-leves-chaise.name: Chair Upward Salute
bras-leves-chaise.description: Sitting at the edge of a chair, feet firmly grounded, raise both arms toward the ceiling, lengthening the side body.
benefits: Opens the chest and the breath

cobra.name: Cobra
cobra.description: Lying on your belly, hands under the shoulders, lift your chest while keeping the pelvis on the floor, elbows close to the body.

sphinx.name: Sphinx
sphinx.description: Lying on your belly, forearms on the floor, elbows under the shoulders, chest lifted.

chien-tete-en-haut.name: Upward-Facing Dog
chien-tete-en-haut.description: On your hands and the tops of your feet, legs and pelvis lifted off the floor, chest open and forward.

sauterelle.name: Locust
sauterelle.description: On your belly, lift your chest, arms and legs at the same time.
benefits: Strengthens the entire back of the body

arc.name: Bow
arc.description: On your belly, catch your ankles and press the feet into your hands to lift the chest and thighs.

pont.name: Bridge
pont.description: Lying on your back, feet on the floor hip-width apart, lift the pelvis, arms under the body.

roue.name: Wheel
roue.description: Lying on your back, hands by the ears, press into the hands and feet to lift the whole body into an arch.
benefits: Strongly opens the chest and shoulders

poisson.name: Fish
poisson.description: Lying on your back, forearms under the body, lift the chest and gently rest the crown of the head down (or keep the head supported).

genoux-poitrine.name: Knees-to-Chest
genoux-poitrine.description: Lying on your back, draw your knees toward your chest and wrap your arms around them.

torsion-allongee.name: Supine Twist
torsion-allongee.description: Lying on your back, let the knees drop to one side, arms out in a T, gaze to the opposite side.

bebe-heureux.name: Happy Baby
bebe-heureux.description: Lying on your back, knees toward the armpits, hold the outer edges of the feet with the soles facing the ceiling.

papillon-allonge.name: Reclining Bound Angle
papillon-allonge.description: Lying on your back, soles of the feet together, knees falling open (supported by cushions).

savasana.name: Corpse Pose (Savasana)
savasana.description: Lying on your back, legs and arms relaxed, palms facing up, eyes closed, breathing naturally.
contraindications: Late pregnancy (lie on your left side)

demi-grenouille.name: Half Frog
demi-grenouille.description: On your belly, prop up on one forearm while the other hand presses the foot toward your glutes.

crocodile.name: Crocodile
crocodile.description: On your belly, forehead resting on your stacked hands, legs relaxed.

cobra-bas.name: Baby Cobra
cobra-bas.description: On your belly, hands by the ribs, lift the chest slightly without pushing into the hands.

main-orteil-allonge.name: Reclining Hand-to-Big-Toe
main-orteil-allonge.description: Lying on your back, lift one straight leg and hold it with a strap or your hand.
benefits: Stretches the hamstrings without loading the back

chiffre-quatre.name: Reclined Figure Four
chiffre-quatre.description: Lying on your back, ankle crossed over the opposite knee, draw the legs toward your chest.

pont-une-jambe.name: One-Legged Bridge
pont-une-jambe.description: From Bridge, extend one leg toward the ceiling while keeping the pelvis level.

banane.name: Banana
banane.description: Lying on your back, walk your feet and arms toward the same side to form a crescent shape.

genou-poitrine-une-jambe.name: Wind-Relieving Pose
genou-poitrine-une-jambe.description: Lying on your back, draw one knee toward your chest, the other leg extended.

heros-allonge.name: Reclining Hero
heros-allonge.description: From Hero, lower your back toward the floor (onto cushions if needed).
benefits: Stretches the quadriceps and the front body

pont-soutenu.name: Supported Bridge
pont-soutenu.description: Lying on your back with a block under the sacrum, arms relaxed.

poisson-soutenu.name: Supported Fish
poisson-soutenu.description: Lie back on a bolster placed along the spine or under the shoulder blades, arms open.

montagne-allongee.name: Reclining Mountain
montagne-allongee.description: Lying on your back, legs together and active, feet flexed, arms alongside the body: the alignment of Mountain, on the floor.

etirement-allonge.name: Reclining Full-Body Stretch
etirement-allonge.description: Lying on your back, arms extended on the floor overhead, lengthen from fingertips to heels as you exhale.
benefits: Frees the shoulders and side body

repos-genoux-flechis.name: Constructive Rest
repos-genoux-flechis.description: Lying on your back, knees bent, feet flat hip-width apart, lower back releasing toward the floor, hands on the belly.

bascule-bassin.name: Pelvic Tilts
bascule-bassin.description: Lying on your back, knees bent, tuck the pelvis to press the lower back into the floor as you exhale, then arch slightly as you inhale.

bercement-dos.name: Rocking on the Back
bercement-dos.description: Knees hugged into the chest, back rounded, rock back and forth along the spine.

demi-bebe-heureux.name: Half Happy Baby
demi-bebe-heureux.description: Lying on your back, one leg extended on the floor, the other knee toward the armpit, hand holding the outer edge of the foot, sole facing up.
benefits: More accessible version of Happy Baby

main-orteil-allonge-ouvert.name: Reclining Hand-to-Big-Toe, Leg Open
main-orteil-allonge-ouvert.description: From the leg reaching up, open it out to the side toward the floor while keeping the other hip grounded (block under the thigh if needed).
benefits: Stretches the inner thighs and adductors

main-orteil-allonge-croise.name: Revolved Reclining Hand-to-Big-Toe
main-orteil-allonge-croise.description: Lying on your back, the opposite hand holds the straight leg and carries it across the body, the other arm open on the floor.
benefits: Stretches the outer hip and IT band

posture-facile-allongee.name: Reclining Easy Pose
posture-facile-allongee.description: Lying on your back, legs crossed as in Easy Pose, knees open and supported if needed, arms relaxed.

relaxation-genoux-soutenus.name: Supported Corpse
relaxation-genoux-soutenus.description: Like final relaxation, with a bolster or rolled blanket under the knees to release the lower back.
contraindications: Late pregnancy (lie on your left side)

relaxation-jambes-chaise.name: Legs on a Chair
relaxation-jambes-chaise.description: Lying on your back, calves resting on the seat of a chair, knees and hips at right angles, arms relaxed.

pont-soutenu-jambes-allongees.name: Supported Bridge, Legs Extended
pont-soutenu-jambes-allongees.description: Pelvis and back resting on bolsters placed lengthwise, shoulders and head on the floor, legs extended, arms open.

vishnu-couche.name: Side-Reclining Leg Lift
vishnu-couche.description: Lying on your side, head supported by your hand, lift the top leg toward the ceiling and catch the big toe.

relaxation-cote.name: Side-Lying Rest
relaxation-cote.description: Lying on your side, top knee bent (on a cushion), head resting on your arm or a cushion.
benefits: An accessible rest when lying on the back is uncomfortable

etirement-quadriceps-cote.name: Side-Lying Quad Stretch
etirement-quadriceps-cote.description: Lying on your side, head on your arm, bend the top leg and hold the foot to bring the heel toward your glutes.

livre-ouvert.name: Open Book
livre-ouvert.description: Lying on your side, knees bent at right angles, arms extended in front; open the top arm to the other side, following your hand with your gaze.
benefits: Mobilizes the thoracic spine in rotation

torsion-genou-croise.name: Supine Twist, Knee Across
torsion-genou-croise.description: Lying on your back, one leg extended, the other knee bent and crossing to the other side, held by the opposite hand, the other arm open.

torsion-aigle-allongee.name: Eagle-Legs Supine Twist
torsion-aigle-allongee.description: Lying on your back, thighs wrapped as in Eagle, let the knees drop toward the side of the top leg, arms out in a T.

torsion-crocodile.name: Crocodile Twist
torsion-crocodile.description: Lying on your back, arms out in a T, legs straight, one heel resting on the toes of the other foot; roll the legs to one side while turning the head the other way.

essuie-glace.name: Windshield Wipers
essuie-glace.description: Lying on your back with feet flat and wider than your hips, let both knees fall to one side, then the other, in rhythm with your breath.
benefits: Mobilizes the hips and lower back

ventre-tourne.name: Revolved Abdomen
ventre-tourne.description: Lying on your back with arms out in a T, raise straight legs to vertical, then lower them together to one side without lifting the opposite shoulder.

jambes-levees.name: Legs Raised Up
jambes-levees.description: Lying on your back, raise both straight legs to vertical, lower back on the floor, arms alongside the body.
benefits: Stretches the backs of the legs

descente-jambes.name: Leg Lowers
descente-jambes.description: From legs at vertical, slowly lower them toward the floor while keeping the lower back pressed down, then lift them back up.

ciseaux.name: Scissor Legs
ciseaux.description: Lying on your back with straight legs, alternate one leg toward the ceiling and the other near the floor, switching with each breath.

bicyclette.name: Bicycle
bicyclette.description: Hands behind your head and upper body slightly lifted, pedal by bringing one knee toward the opposite elbow while the other leg extends.

insecte-mort.name: Dead Bug
insecte-mort.description: Lying on your back with knees bent at 90 degrees over the hips and arms reaching up, extend one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor, lower back pressed down.
benefits: Strengthens the core without straining the neck

releve-buste.name: Crunch
releve-buste.description: Lying on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head, lift your head and shoulder blades as you exhale, chin slightly tucked.

aigle-allonge.name: Reclining Eagle
aigle-allonge.description: Lying on your back with arms and legs wrapped as in Eagle, draw elbows and knees together while lifting your head and shoulders.
benefits: Stretches the upper back and outer hips

poisson-jambes-levees.name: Raised Legs Fish
poisson-jambes-levees.description: From Fish, with the crown of the head on the floor, lift straight legs to 45 degrees and extend the arms parallel to the legs, palms together.

pont-dynamique.name: Dynamic Bridge
pont-dynamique.description: On your back with feet flat, inhale to lift the hips vertebra by vertebra while taking the arms overhead to the floor; exhale to come back down.

poisson-lotus.name: Fish in Lotus
poisson-lotus.description: With legs in Lotus, lie back and arch the upper back until the crown of the head rests on the floor, hands holding the feet.

preparation-roue.name: Wheel Preparation
preparation-roue.description: Feet flat, hands beside the ears with fingers pointing toward the shoulders, lift the hips and rest the crown of the head on the floor, elbows parallel.
benefits: Prepares the shoulders and wrists for Wheel

roue-une-jambe.name: One-Legged Wheel
roue-une-jambe.description: From Wheel, shift your weight onto one foot and extend the other leg toward the ceiling.
benefits: Strengthens the arms, glutes and standing leg

baton-inverse.name: Two-Legged Inverted Staff
baton-inverse.description: From Wheel, lower the forearms and crown of the head to the floor with hands clasped behind the head, then walk the legs out straight.
benefits: Deeply opens the shoulders and chest

pont-sur-la-tete.name: Head Bridge
pont-sur-la-tete.description: Crown of the head and feet on the floor, legs straight, hips lifted and arms crossed over the chest.

sommeil-yogi.name: Yogic Sleep
sommeil-yogi.description: Lying on your back, slide both legs behind your head with ankles crossed and bind the hands behind your back.
benefits: Deeply stretches the hips and back

demi-heros-allonge.name: Half Reclining Hero
demi-heros-allonge.description: Seated with one leg folded in Hero (foot beside the hip) and the other straight, lower your back toward the floor or onto a bolster.
benefits: Stretches one quadriceps at a time

tete-vache-allongee.name: Reclining Cow Face
tete-vache-allongee.description: Lying on your back, cross one thigh over the other with knees stacked, and draw the feet toward the chest with your hands.
benefits: Stretches the outer hips and glutes
Reclining alternative to seated Cow Face

arc-lateral.name: Side Bow
arc-lateral.description: From Bow, roll onto one side while keeping hold of the ankles and the bow shape, then come back and switch sides.

relaxation-ventre.name: Reversed Corpse
relaxation-ventre.description: Lying on your belly, arms extended forward on the floor, forehead resting down, legs relaxed.

demi-sauterelle.name: Half Locust
demi-sauterelle.description: On your belly with chin on the floor and arms under or alongside the body, lift one straight leg without rotating the pelvis.
benefits: Strengthens the glutes and lower back

sauterelle-jambes.name: Legs-Only Locust
sauterelle-jambes.description: On your belly with chin on the floor and hands under the thighs or in fists, lift both straight legs together.
benefits: Powerfully strengthens the lower back and glutes

sauterelle-bras-tendus.name: Superman Locust
sauterelle-bras-tendus.description: On your belly with arms extended forward, lift arms, chest and legs together, lengthening the body in both directions.

nageur.name: Swimmer
nageur.description: On your belly with arms extended forward, lift one arm and the opposite leg, then alternate while keeping the pelvis steady.

serpent.name: Snake
serpent.description: On your belly with hands clasped behind your back, lift the chest while drawing the hands toward the feet.
benefits: Opens the chest and front of the shoulders

cobra-tourne.name: Twisting Cobra
cobra-tourne.description: From Cobra with feet apart, turn your head and shoulders to look over one shoulder at the opposite heel.

demi-arc.name: Half Bow
demi-arc.description: On your belly, supported on one forearm or with that arm extended forward, the other hand catches the same-side ankle and the leg kicks back to lift the thigh.

arc-complet.name: Full Bow
arc-complet.description: From Bow, take hold of the toes with elbows pointing up and draw the feet toward the head.
benefits: Strongly opens the shoulders and chest

grenouille-ventre.name: Frog (Prone)
grenouille-ventre.description: On your belly with the chest lifted, bend both knees and press the feet down beside the hips, elbows pointing up.

roi-cobra.name: King Cobra
roi-cobra.description: From Cobra with straight arms, bend the knees and bring the feet toward the head as it drops back.
benefits: Deep backbend through the whole spine

grande-sauterelle.name: Full Locust
grande-sauterelle.description: Chin and chest on the floor, arms under the body, lift the legs up over the back toward the head.

torsion-ventre.name: Prone Twist
torsion-ventre.description: Lying on your belly with arms out in a T, bend one leg and take it over the other to place the foot on the floor on the other side.
benefits: Opens the front of the hip and the shoulder

chien-tete-en-bas.name: Downward-Facing Dog
chien-tete-en-bas.description: Hands and feet on the floor, hips high, body in an inverted V, heels reaching toward the floor, neck relaxed.

chien-trois-pattes.name: Three-Legged Dog
chien-trois-pattes.description: From Downward-Facing Dog, lift one leg in line with the back.

planche.name: Plank
planche.description: Hands under the shoulders, body in one line from head to heels, abdominals engaged.
benefits: Strengthens the arms, shoulders and core

chaturanga.name: Chaturanga
chaturanga.description: From Plank, lower halfway down while keeping the elbows hugged in alongside the body.
benefits: Strengthens the arms, wrists and core

planche-laterale.name: Side Plank
planche-laterale.description: Balancing on one hand and the outer edge of the foot, body aligned in profile, top arm reaching up.
benefits: Strengthens the arms, wrists and obliques

dauphin.name: Dolphin
dauphin.description: Like Downward-Facing Dog but on the forearms, hips high.
benefits: Strengthens the shoulders and upper back

chose-sauvage.name: Wild Thing
chose-sauvage.description: From Side Plank, step the top foot behind you and open the hips and chest toward the ceiling.

corbeau.name: Crow
corbeau.description: Squatting with hands on the floor and elbows slightly bent, rest the knees on the backs of the upper arms, shift your weight forward and lift the feet.

chandelle.name: Shoulder Stand
chandelle.description: On the shoulders with hands supporting the back, legs extended toward the ceiling (blanket under the shoulders).

charrue.name: Plow
charrue.description: From Shoulder Stand, lower the feet to the floor behind your head.

posture-sur-les-avant-bras.name: Forearm Stand
posture-sur-les-avant-bras.description: Vertical balance on the forearms, legs reaching up (practice at the wall at first).

poirier.name: Headstand
poirier.description: Forearms on the floor, fingers interlaced, crown of the head down, legs lifted to vertical.

arbre-droit.name: Handstand
arbre-droit.description: Vertical balance on the hands, arms straight, body aligned (at the wall at first).

jambes-au-mur.name: Legs Up the Wall
jambes-au-mur.description: Lying on your back with the buttocks against the wall, legs extended up the wall.

corbeau-lateral.name: Side Crow
corbeau-lateral.description: Squatting, turn the knees to one side, place the hands on the floor, rest the thighs on one arm and lift the feet.

luciole.name: Firefly
luciole.description: Hands on the floor between the legs, thighs resting on the upper arms, legs extended forward.

huit-angles.name: Eight-Angle
huit-angles.description: Legs crossed and hooked around one arm, torso leaning forward, body parallel to the floor.

poirier-tripode.name: Tripod Headstand
poirier-tripode.description: Crown of the head and hands on the floor in a triangle, knees resting on the elbows, then legs up toward the ceiling.

oreilles-pressees.name: Ear-Pressure Pose
oreilles-pressees.description: From Plow, bring the knees down beside the ears.

chien-genoux-flechis.name: Bent-Knee Downward Dog
chien-genoux-flechis.description: Like Downward-Facing Dog, but with knees bent and heels lifted to lengthen the back first and send the sitting bones up.
benefits: Lengthens the spine without straining the hamstrings

chien-trois-pattes-hanche-ouverte.name: Three-Legged Dog, Open Hip
chien-trois-pattes-hanche-ouverte.description: From Three-Legged Dog, bend the lifted knee and open the hip to the side, heel toward the opposite buttock, hands firmly grounded.
benefits: Opens the front of the hip and the side body

chien-genou-nez.name: Downward Dog Knee to Nose
chien-genou-nez.description: From Three-Legged Dog, shift the shoulders over the wrists, round the back and draw the knee toward the nose.

chien-tete-en-bas-torsion.name: Revolved Downward Dog
chien-tete-en-bas-torsion.description: From Downward-Facing Dog with feet slightly apart, take hold of the opposite ankle or calf with one hand and rotate the torso.
benefits: Stretches the backs of the legs and the shoulders

dauphin-une-jambe.name: One-Legged Dolphin
dauphin-une-jambe.description: From Dolphin, lift one straight leg in line with the back without letting the hip open.

demi-chandelle.name: Half Shoulder Stand
demi-chandelle.description: Lying down, lift the legs and support the hips with your hands, elbows on the floor; the torso stays angled and the legs hover above the face.

chandelle-une-jambe.name: One-Legged Shoulder Stand
chandelle-une-jambe.description: From Shoulder Stand, lower one straight leg toward the floor behind your head while the other stays vertical.

chandelle-sans-appui.name: Unsupported Shoulder Stand
chandelle-sans-appui.description: From Shoulder Stand, release the hands from the back and extend the arms up alongside the legs.

chandelle-lotus.name: Lotus in Shoulder Stand
chandelle-lotus.description: From Shoulder Stand, cross the legs into Lotus and keep the knees pointing up, hands on the back.

embryon-chandelle.name: Embryo in Shoulder Stand
embryon-chandelle.description: From Lotus in Shoulder Stand, lower the knees toward the forehead and wrap the arms around the legs.

charrue-jambes-ecartees.name: Wide-Legged Plow
charrue-jambes-ecartees.description: From Plow, spread the feet wide on the floor behind your head and, if possible, take hold of the big toes.
benefits: Stretches the backs and inner legs

charrue-laterale.name: Side Plow
charrue-laterale.description: From Plow with hands on the back, walk both feet together to one side of the head while keeping the hips supported.
benefits: Stretches the back and side body

demi-poirier.name: Half Headstand
demi-poirier.description: From Headstand, lower the straight legs to horizontal and hold, or lift them to that point from the floor.
benefits: Strongly strengthens the core and shoulders

poirier-une-jambe.name: One-Legged Headstand
poirier-une-jambe.description: From Headstand, lower one straight leg to the floor in front of the face while the other stays vertical.

poirier-lotus.name: Lotus in Headstand
poirier-lotus.description: In Headstand, cross the legs into Lotus, keeping the knees pointing up and the weight on the forearms.

poirier-mains-libres.name: Free-Hands Headstand
poirier-mains-libres.description: Crown of the head on the floor, arms extended forward with palms down, legs vertical.

demi-equilibre-mains-mur.name: L-Shaped Handstand
demi-equilibre-mains-mur.description: Hands on the floor one leg's length from the wall, walk the feet up the wall to hip height to form an L, arms straight.
benefits: A safe way to get comfortable upside down

scorpion.name: Scorpion
scorpion.description: From Forearm Stand, lift the head, arch the back and bend the knees to bring the feet toward the head.
benefits: Opens the chest and front body

scorpion-sur-les-mains.name: Handstand Scorpion
scorpion-sur-les-mains.description: From Handstand, arch the back and bend the knees to lower the feet toward the head, gaze between the hands.

visage-formidable.name: Formidable Face Pose
visage-formidable.description: Chin, shoulders and chest on the floor, hands close to the ribs; the legs lift into a deep backbend and come down on either side of the head.
benefits: Deeply opens the spine and chest
contraindications: Very advanced practice, under supervision only

grue.name: Crane Pose
grue.description: Like Crow, but with straight arms: knees high up under the armpits, hips lifted, feet drawn together toward the buttocks.
benefits: Strengthens the arms, wrists and core

corbeau-une-jambe.name: One-Legged Crow
corbeau-une-jambe.description: From Crow, keep one knee on the arm and extend the other leg long behind you.

corbeau-volant.name: Flying Pigeon
corbeau-volant.description: One ankle crossed over the opposite knee in a figure 4, shin resting on the backs of the arms, back leg extended up and back.

koundinya-1.name: Eka Pada Koundinyasana I
koundinya-1.description: Like Side Crow, arms in Chaturanga, the top leg extended out to the side and the other leg extended behind.

koundinya-2.name: Eka Pada Koundinyasana II
koundinya-2.description: Arms in Chaturanga, one leg extended forward over the outside of the arm, the other extended far behind, like a suspended split.

corbeau-lateral-jambes-tendues.name: Two-Legged Koundinya
corbeau-lateral-jambes-tendues.description: From Side Crow, extend both legs together out to the side, body parallel to the floor.
benefits: Strengthens the arms, shoulders and obliques

libellule.name: Dragonfly
libellule.description: In a twist, one foot rests on the opposite upper arm, the other leg extends to the side, torso horizontal over bent arms.

vishvamitra.name: Vishvamitrasana
vishvamitra.description: Supported on one hand and the back foot, the front leg passes over the supporting arm and extends toward the sky while the other hand holds the foot.

jambe-sur-le-bras.name: Elephant's Trunk Pose
jambe-sur-le-bras.description: Seated, rest one thigh high on the arm on the same side, hands on the floor on each side, then lift the hips and the leg extended in front of you.
benefits: Stretches the backs of the legs

pression-epaules.name: Shoulder-Pressing Pose
pression-epaules.description: Hands on the floor between the feet, thighs resting high on the arms; lift the feet and cross the ankles in front of you.
benefits: Strengthens the arms, wrists and core

pendentif.name: Pendant Pose
pendentif.description: Kneeling with ankles crossed and hands on the floor beside the knees, round the back and lift the knees and feet, swinging gently.

balance-lotus.name: Scale Pose
balance-lotus.description: Sitting in Lotus with palms flat beside the hips, press into the arms to lift the whole body off the floor.
benefits: Strengthens the arms, wrists and abdominals

coq.name: Rooster Pose
coq.description: In Lotus, slide the arms between thighs and calves up to the elbows, palms flat, then lift the body.

coq-leve.name: Upward Rooster
coq-leve.description: With the legs in Lotus, place the knees high on the backs of the arms and tip forward as in Crow.

paon.name: Peacock Pose
paon.description: Hands on the floor with fingers pointing toward the feet, elbows tucked into the belly; tip forward to lift the body horizontal.
benefits: Strengthens the wrists, forearms and back

paon-lotus.name: Lotus Peacock
paon-lotus.description: Like Peacock, but with the legs crossed in Lotus, knees close to the floor as a counterweight.
benefits: A more compact version of Peacock

jambes-au-mur-papillon.name: Butterfly Legs Up the Wall
